# Faculty setup {#faculty-team}

:::: {.callout type="yellow" title="Update"}

  Note that as of September 2026, this process has changed. You will now add your faculty *directly to the repository*, skipping the Team creation step. This means you won't have to go through the Platform Training Manager to add external collaborators. Hooray!
  
::::

1.  Go to your repository's settings, then Collaborators and Teams on the left sidebar.
2.  Use the Add button on the top right to add your instructors/TAs/sysadmin directly to the repository with *maintain* access. Note that this will send them an email invite that they must accept.
